# Tomorrow

<!-- Generated by tools/theme-readme-gen.py from scheme.toml; do not edit. -->

Terminal-inspired colors for GNOME (GTK 3, GTK 4 and libadwaita, GNOME Shell) and for terminals and command-line tools. Variants: dark and light.

![Tomorrow dark palette](palette-dark.svg)

![Tomorrow light palette](palette-light.svg)

- Colors: Tomorrow (colours of the Ptyxis built-in 'Tomorrow Night' and 'Tomorrow'; origin named in the built-in's header: https://github.com/Gogh-Co/Gogh/tree/master/themes/Tomorrow%20Night.yml).
- Default accent: yellow (#F0C674); the other accents are listed by `switch-theme`.
- Ptyxis uses its built-in palette `Tomorrow Night` (light: `Tomorrow`).

## Install and use

```
ujust gnome-candy install-theme tomorrow
ujust gnome-candy switch-theme tomorrow
```

Without the image recipe, run `just install-theme tomorrow` and `just switch-theme tomorrow` in a checkout of [candy-for-gnome](https://github.com/redcodeworks/candy-for-gnome).
